newsitem.title: UK: Transco says nine injured in gas depot blast.
newsitem.headline: Transco says nine injured in gas depot blast.

text.p: BG plc unit Transco said on Thursday nine people were injured in an explosion at one its gas depots in Runcorn, northwest England.
A spokesman for the company said seven of the injured had been taken to a hospital burns unit and another two to a different hospital.
"We had some men working on a medium pressure main and there was a gas escape which ignited. We don't know exactly what happened," said a spokesman for Transco, BG's pipeline and storage arm.
He said the men had been trying to repair a gas escape at the depot, which he believed was already redundant.
Fire services said at midnight that the depot was ablaze and "still burning out of control."
Ten fire engines were at the scene, the area was cordoned off and nearby houses evacuated.
The local ambulance service said that four of the nine injured were thought to be in a serious condition.
